    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")

    # --- Sample layout ---
    inputs = [("A1", "A1"), ("B1", "B1"), ("C1", "C1"), ("D1", "D1")]
    references = [("A2", "A2"), ("B2", "B2")]
    splits = [("A1", "E1"), ("B1", "E2"), ("C1", "E3"), ("D1", "E4")]

    # Aliquot volume (µL) - kept below the 50 µL tip capacity to

    # --- Build the freeze plan: inputs -> references -> splits ---
    freeze_plan = (
        [("INPUT", s, d) for s, d in inputs]
        + [("REFERENCE", s, d) for s, d in references]
        + [("SPLIT", s, d) for s, d in splits]
    )

    # --- Execute transfers ---
